description: Implement Orchestration patterns (sequential, parallel, router, critic, retry with budget), Model Router with multi-provider LLM abstraction and cost tracking, Tool Registry with MCP protocol support and permission-based access, Trigger/Aware system (cron, interval, webhook, on_message scheduling and execution), and Governance layer (approval engine, budget enforcer, guardrails, RBAC, audit logging, kill switch/circuit breaker).
steps: Create src/nexus/orchestration/__init__.py.

Create src/nexus/orchestration/planner.py with TaskPlanner class: decompose_task(task) -> list[SubTask] that breaks a complex task into ordered subtasks with dependencies. Include SubTask dataclass (id, description, dependencies, assigned_agent_id, status).

Create src/nexus/orchestration/router.py with AgentRouter class: route_task(task, available_agents) -> Agent that matches tasks to the best agent based on skills, availability, workload, and budget. Include scoring logic.

Create src/nexus/orchestration/parallel.py with ParallelExecutor class: execute_parallel(tasks, agents) -> list[TaskResult] using asyncio.gather with configurable concurrency limit. Handle partial failures gracefully.
Create src/nexus/orchestration/critic.py with CriticEvaluator class: evaluate(task, result) -> EvaluationResult with score (0-1), feedback, and pass/fail. Configurable quality threshold.

Create src/nexus/orchestration/retry.py with RetryWithBudget class: execute_with_retry(task, agent, max_retries, budget_limit_cents) that retries failed tasks up to max_retries or until budget is exhausted. Track cumulative cost across retries.
Create src/nexus/models_router/__init__.py.

Create src/nexus/models_router/router.py with ModelRouter class: select_model(task_type, complexity, budget_remaining) -> ModelConfig. Define ModelConfig dataclass (provider, model_name, max_tokens, temperature). Include task-type-to-model mapping configuration.

Create src/nexus/models_router/providers/__init__.py with LLMProvider Protocol: complete(messages, model_config) -> LLMResponse, stream(messages, model_config) -> AsyncIterator[str], count_tokens(text, model) -> int.
Create src/nexus/models_router/providers/openai.py with OpenAIProvider implementing LLMProvider protocol. Async httpx-based client.
Create src/nexus/models_router/providers/anthropic.py with AnthropicProvider implementing LLMProvider protocol.
Create src/nexus/models_router/providers/google.py with GoogleProvider implementing LLMProvider protocol.
Create src/nexus/models_router/providers/ollama.py with OllamaProvider implementing LLMProvider protocol (for local models).

Create src/nexus/models_router/cost_tracker.py with CostTracker class: record_invocation(provider, model, input_tokens, output_tokens, agent_id, task_id), get_cost_for_invocation(provider, model, input_tokens, output_tokens) -> int (cents). Include pricing table for common models.
Create src/nexus/tools/__init__.py.

Create src/nexus/tools/registry.py with ToolRegistry class: register_tool(tool), get_tool(tool_id), list_tools(company_id, filters), discover_tools(agent_id) -> list of tools agent has access to. Include ToolDefinition dataclass with JSON schema for parameters.

Create src/nexus/tools/mcp_client.py with MCPClient class: connect(server_url), list_tools() -> list[MCPTool], call_tool(tool_name, arguments) -> MCPResult, disconnect(). Implement MCP protocol basics (initialize, tools/list, tools/call).
Create src/nexus/tools/executor.py with ToolExecutor class: execute(agent_id, tool_id, arguments) -> ToolResult. Check permissions via ToolAccess, log to audit, enforce rate limits, handle timeouts.
Create src/nexus/triggers/__init__.py.

Create src/nexus/triggers/scheduler.py with TriggerScheduler class: register_trigger(trigger), unregister_trigger(trigger_id), get_due_triggers() -> list of triggers whose next_fire_at <= now, update_next_fire(trigger) based on type (cron uses croniter-style logic, interval adds timedelta). Support trigger types: cron, once, interval.
Create src/nexus/triggers/webhook.py with WebhookHandler class: register_webhook(trigger_id, path), handle_incoming(path, payload) -> fires matching trigger, list_webhooks(company_id).

Create src/nexus/triggers/executor.py with TriggerExecutor class: fire_trigger(trigger) that creates a TriggerExecution record, wakes the associated agent, and executes the configured action. Track execution duration and result.
Create src/nexus/governance/__init__.py.

Create src/nexus/governance/approvals.py with ApprovalEngine class: submit_for_approval(request) -> Approval, process_approval(approval_id, decision, decided_by), check_auto_approve(request, policies) -> bool. Auto-approve based on: cost below threshold, trusted agent, pre-approved action type.

Create src/nexus/governance/budget_enforcer.py with BudgetEnforcer class: check_can_spend(scope_type, scope_id, amount_cents) -> BudgetDecision (allowed/warning/denied), get_remaining_budget(scope_type, scope_id) -> int, on_cost_event(event) that updates spent counters and checks thresholds.

Create src/nexus/governance/guardrails.py with GuardrailChain class: validate(output, rules) -> GuardrailResult. Include guardrail types: StructuralGuardrail (JSON schema validation), ContentGuardrail (blocked patterns, max length), PolicyGuardrail (configurable rules). Chain runs all guards and returns first failure or pass.

Create src/nexus/governance/rbac.py with RBACManager class: check_permission(actor_id, actor_type, action, resource_type, resource_id) -> bool, grant_permission(actor_id, permission), revoke_permission(actor_id, permission), get_permissions(actor_id) -> list. Define Permission dataclass and standard roles (admin, manager, agent, viewer).

Create src/nexus/governance/audit.py with AuditLogger class: log(actor_type, actor_id, action, resource_type, resource_id, details, company_id). Async - writes to AuditLog table. Include convenience methods: log_agent_action, log_user_action, log_system_action.

Create src/nexus/governance/kill_switch.py with KillSwitch class: activate(company_id, reason) pauses all agents in company, activate_agent(agent_id, reason) pauses single agent, deactivate(company_id), is_active(company_id) -> bool. Also CircuitBreaker class: record_failure(agent_id), record_success(agent_id), is_open(agent_id) -> bool (open after N consecutive failures, auto-reset after cooldown).
